mŏnŏbŏlon , i, n., = μόνοσ-βόλος,
I.a single throw, i. e. leaping alone, a game in which various feats of bodily agility are performed without the aid of a leapingpole; “diff. from the contomonobolon, where the performer is furnished with such a pole (post-class.),” Cod. Just. 3, 43, 3 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
